design_philosophy: Microsoft Azure / DevOps inspired. Clean, professional, white theme. Emphasizes data density, strict grid hierarchy, and functional clarity over decorative elements. Uses sharp edges, structural grayscale, and a dominant blue accent for actions.

grid_strategy.description: Dense, data-correlation focused. Base grid is 12 columns. Every pixel utilized. H-full on children.
grid_strategy.page_layout: Left sidebar (w-64) + main content area. Top header for breadcrumbs and global actions.
grid_strategy.card_surface: Grid Borders: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#EDEBE9), no shadow. Hover: border color darkens slightly, no lift.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Focus on border color changes and background fills. No scaling or bouncing.

icons_and_assets.style: Clean, unstyled line icons. Sized 16px to 20px.

testing_requirements.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-users', data-testid='submit-item-btn', data-testid='log-viewer-container'

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a standard left sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile) and top header layout.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default rounded corners to be `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`, and use the provided #0078D4 blue instead of the default black/white Vercel aesthetic.
For the Logs Viewer, use a pure HTML/Tailwind block styled to look like an IDE terminal (dark bg, monospace font).
Server Status should be a dense grid of Metric cards (CPU, Memory, Disk, Network) with simple Recharts line/area charts.
Variables Management should be a clear Data Table with inline or modal-based CRUD operations.
API Endpoints display should just be a clean, read-only list with copy-to-clipboard buttons.
Ensure all text color combinations meet at least AA accessibility contrast standards.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Make sure to import them via Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Remember to include `data-testid` attributes everywhere to support robust testing.
